item.title: A Restored Croft House in The Quiet of Sollas
item.description: Set in the crofting township of Sollas on North Uist, this restored stone house offers open plan living, generous garden ground, and access to some of the island’s most beautiful beaches, combining calm interiors with a deeply grounded island setting.The post A Restored Croft House in The Quiet of Sollas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Seven Charged After £7.1m Cannabis Farm Found in Wick
item.description: A £7.1million cannabis farm uncovered inside a derelict school in Wick has led to seven people being charged, as Police Scotland continue efforts to disrupt organised drug supply and limit the harm illegal substances cause to communities across the Highlands.The post Seven Charged After £7.1m Cannabis Farm Found in Wick appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inverness Leisure Set To Host Major World Cup Fanzone
item.description: Inverness Leisure is preparing to host the Highlands’ largest indoor World Cup Fanzone, bringing fans together to watch all three of Scotland’s group matches in a family friendly setting designed around community, atmosphere and shared national pride.The post Inverness Leisure Set To Host Major World Cup Fanzone appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Sutherland Cup Draw Made as Highland Industrial Supplies Extend Sponsorship to 2027
item.description: The 2026 Sutherland Cup draw has been made in Inverness as Highland Industrial Supplies confirmed an extension of their sponsorship through to 2027, reinforcing long standing support for junior shinty’s most prestigious competition.The post Sutherland Cup Draw Made as Highland Industrial Supplies Extend Sponsorship to 2027 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Travel Support Scheme Opens for Talented Highland Athletes
item.description: Talented Highland athletes can now apply for travel funding of up to £750 through the Athlete Travel Award Scheme, a partnership between sportscotland and High Life Highland designed to reduce the cost barriers of training and competition for performance level sportspeople.The post Travel Support Scheme Opens for Talented Highland Athletes appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Pressure Grows on Starmer Over Labour Together Spying Allegations
item.description: Pressure is mounting on Keir Starmer to launch an investigation into claims that Labour Together commissioned research into journalists, with allegations raising serious questions about judgement, transparency, and the role of senior figures close to the Prime Minister.The post Pressure Grows on Starmer Over Labour Together Spying Allegations appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Calls Grow for Mandatory Reporting of Salmon Farm Deaths in Scotland
item.description: Pressure is mounting on the Scottish Government to require mandatory reporting of salmon farm deaths after inspectors uncovered more than 400,000 unreported fish deaths in 2025, prompting renewed calls from Ariane Burgess MSP for a halt to new farms and expansions.The post Calls Grow for Mandatory Reporting of Salmon Farm Deaths in Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Thoughtfully Designed Home in The Growing Community of Tornagrain
item.description: Set within the carefully planned town of Tornagrain near Inverness, this modern three bedroom home offers balanced living, an enclosed garden, and strong connectivity, combining contemporary efficiency with a calm village scale setting designed for long term living.The post A Thoughtfully Designed Home in The Growing Community of Tornagrain appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Council Archaeology Fund Backs Six Orkney Projects for 2026
item.description: Six archaeology projects across Orkney will be supported in 2026 through the Council’s £40,000 Archaeology Fund, backing community led research, learning, and heritage work that continues to place Orkney’s past at the heart of its present.The post Council Archaeology Fund Backs Six Orkney Projects for 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: UK Government Sets Out Rural Growth Plans at NFUS Conference
item.description: The UK Government has outlined plans to support farmers, crofters and rural communities at the NFUS conference, highlighting closer partnership working, rural growth initiatives and new measures aimed at strengthening Scotland’s agricultural and food sectors.The post UK Government Sets Out Rural Growth Plans at NFUS Conference appeared first on The Highland Times.
